settings.heading: What's Inside
settings.content: Each sachet contains 100mg Natural Caffeine (from Green Tea Extract), 150mg L-Theanine, 250mg Guarana Extract, Vitamin B6 (2.1mg), Vitamin B12 (5mcg), and Pantothenic Acid (18mg). No synthetic caffeine, no sugar, no artificial colours.

settings.heading: How to Use
settings.content: Mix one sachet with 150–200ml of cold or warm water. Best taken 20–30 minutes before exercise or when you need sustained focus. Avoid taking within 6 hours of bedtime. One sachet per day is the recommended maximum.

settings.heading: The Science
settings.content: The synergy between caffeine and L-Theanine is one of the most consistently proven combinations in sports nutrition research. L-Theanine increases alpha brain waves (calm focus) while caffeine increases alertness — together they produce focused energy without the anxiety that caffeine alone can cause. Natural caffeine from Green Tea is bound to polyphenols, which slow absorption and extend the energy curve.
